claim_under_test.subject: T14a Moderation Gateway
claim_under_test.claim: No verdict from the provider — timeout, outage, malformed response, or no provider configured at all — can ever result in published content. All four collapse to one ProviderUnavailableError with one handler, which holds the item pending and schedules a retry; past an attempt ceiling it auto-escalates to the human queue. It never publishes and never drops.

assertions.assertion: never publishes on a missing verdict
assertions.note: Not falsified by any of 13 injections. Insert + openCase share one transaction (content.service.ts:66-76, :154-163), and every content-mutating statement is guarded by AND moderation_status = 'pending'.
A crash between the insert transaction and the verdict transaction leaves exactly claimRetryableCases' predicate. Statically verified; the kill test itself is deferred (OQ-R1).

assertions.assertion: all four failure modes collapse to one ProviderUnavailableError
assertions.note: Malformed response surfaces as Postgres 23502 (RES-1); 'no provider configured' holds only for UNSET — a misconfigured name surfaces as a plain Error (RES-2). Timeout and outage do collapse correctly.

assertions.assertion: past an attempt ceiling it auto-escalates to the human queue
assertions.result: FALSE in the modes C exposes
assertions.note: recordFailedAttempt sits inside the ProviderUnavailableError branch, so any other error freezes the attempt counter. Observed: 8 retry passes, attempts never left 0, risk_tier never left NULL — held forever and invisible to the S16 escalation index (RES-3).
